notes: Built for the SpotDonalds take-home as a structured, attributed extract of publicly published McDonald's Australia menu and nutrition information. Not affiliated with McDonald's or Spotify.

Direct requests from this environment to mcdonalds.com were blocked by Akamai (HTTP 403). Public pages were read via WebFetch and the r.jina.ai reader. The hidden /dnaapp/ itemDetails API was not used because robots.txt disallows /dnaapp/.

Nutrition values are average quantity per official serve unless otherwise noted. McDonald's Quality Assurance disclaimers apply: values are based on standard formulations and serving sizes and may vary.
energy_kcal is taken from the official 'Energy (kcal)' cell when present. It is only derived (kJ / 4.184, marked energy_kcal_derived true) if that cell is missing.
Tags are inferred from official names, descriptions and categories. They are not an official McDonald's taxonomy.
The average adult daily energy intake cited by McDonald's Australia is 8,700 kJ.
coverage_gaps: No official national price list is published. Terms state that prices vary between restaurants and that McDelivery prices may be higher than pickup, so price_aud is omitted for every item.

The official nutrition index on 13 Nov 2026 (AEDT) no longer linked a Main Food Menu, Main Drinks Menu or Happy Meal Menu PDF. Guessed historical PDF paths returned 404. Core food nutrition in this file therefore comes from official product-page tables, not a single current QA PDF.

McCafé milk alternatives (skim, lactose-free, soy, almond, oat) are published in official PDFs but are not fully exploded as separate items here unless they have their own product URL. Product-page figures should be treated as the standard formulation shown on that page (typically full-cream milk unless the page says otherwise).
Combo / bundle meals often have no item-level nutrition table; components are listed separately.
Wraps and Burgers are website category pages only in the sitemap; individual wrap and burger products are filed under chicken-fish, breakfast or beef.
A dedicated Main Drinks (fountain soft drink) PDF was not listed on the current nutrition index. Cold & Frozen Drink product pages are included where present in the sitemap.
Regional trials (for example Loaded Cookie in NSW/ACT, protein-boosted milk in WA) may not appear as national product pages.
Serving weight is not printed on product pages; serving_size_g is derived from kJ per serve and kJ per 100 g/mL when both are published.
McDonald's states that no food items are certified as vegetarian, so this dataset never applies a certified-vegetarian tag.

items.name: Fries (Large)
items.description: Get them while they're hot. Macca's® fries are the legendary, world-famous side that's been the perfect partner to every burger and Happy Meal for decades. Crispy and golden on the outside, soft and fluffy on the inside. Made from the highest-quality potatoes, cut into those iconic skinny strands and cooked to order. It's the simple things that make them sing: quality spuds, the right cut, the right cook, a little bit of salt. No shortcuts, no fancy add-ons. Just the kind of fries you can't stop reaching for halfway through the meal. Available in Small, Medium and Large to match every appetite. Best paired with a Big Mac®, McCrispy® or any burger from the Macca's range, plus your favourite dipping sauce. Heading through the Drive-Thru? They're built to travel. Though they rarely make it home untouched. Available after 10:30am. Serving suggestion.

items.name: Hash Brown
items.description: Get 'em hot. The Macca's® hash brown is a brekkie staple. A crunchy, golden-brown crust giving way to steaming, fluffy potato inside. Cooked to order and served piping hot, it's the kind of side that keeps mornings moving. Made from quality potatoes, then pressed, shaped and fried to that signature hash brown crispness. One side, three textures: crunch, fluff, and that comforting potato hit you didn't know you needed at 7am. A breakfast classic on its own, but it really shines paired with a Bacon & Egg McMuffin and a hot McCafé® coffee. Or stacked into a Big Brekkie Burger when the hunger calls for it.
